info.description:
REST API of Nzyme.

Authenticate with an API key created on your user profile page, sent as a bearer token:
`Authorization: Bearer nzk_...`. API keys carry the permissions of the user that created them.
Endpoints that manage credentials (passwords, MFA, API keys, sessions) require an interactive
session and reject API keys.
info.title: Nzyme REST API
